_meta.owner: QA automation engineer (the backend reads it for seed.sql; the release validator reads it for RC accounts)
_meta.use: Local stack and the dev project only. Never prod. Sign in with email OTP; the local stack's mail catcher (Inbucket/Mailpit) receives the codes. There are no passwords in this file.
_meta.dates: Every date is relative to the moment the scenario is seeded: day_offset 0 = today in the couple's timezone, -1 = yesterday.
_meta.copy: Answer and message text follows the design boards so screens match them for review and store screenshots. Privacy tests use their own text prefixed FIXTURE- (qa/fixtures/privacy-strings.json, QA-08).
_meta.ids: UUIDs are fixed so tests, seed and E2E flows can refer to them.
